name: Script launcher
description: Run, with one click, the programs and scripts you have saved.
intro: Only the commands you save can be run. No shell: arguments are passed as they are, one per line. Maximum run time: 60 seconds.
name: Name
programHint: Full path to an .exe, or the name of an .exe found on PATH. .bat, .cmd and .ps1 files are not run directly.
timedOut: Timed out: the program was stopped after 60 seconds.

errors.invalid_command: Give a name and a program.
errors.program_not_found: Program not found. Check the path or PATH.
